header: THE YEARLY AND CUMULATIVE FIGURES of the steel card, which I keep by hand: they come from the Ministry of Steel's "An Overview of Steel Sector" (September 2026) and from Annexure I and III of its September 2026 Monthly Economic Report, not from the ten monthly reports that scripts/steel/refresh-mos.py reads (those are in mos.ts, which that script rewrites). When a newer Overview or report comes out, copy its tables here.

doc: I show SAIL's cumulative figures for April to September as the September 2026 report states them (million tonnes, MT; the Ministry states them in lakh tonnes), this year against last. They are shown as the Ministry gives them, not added up from the months (which differ in the second decimal by revisions).
